verdict.rationale: Cursor is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents as an official MCP server is a different product role. Its MCP evidence covers only connecting to external servers (client-side), which cannot be credited here. ACP over stdio is a different protocol, and the probe found no hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.cursor.com does not resolve) and no 'mcp serve' mode.
